Hourly microstructure and spot-flow fields are complete, but the direct Binance spot owner was disabled; neither those fields nor missing direct spot confirmation establish durable buying. Sentiment-owner capture passed without a supplied directional sentiment conclusion. The evidence does not confirm distribution.
